system.description:
As long as a Jaffa has a symbiote, they may choose to gain advantage on any physical save (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution). A Jaffa may use this 
ability once per Proficiency Bonus (minimum 1), replenishing the uses during a long rest. If a Jaffa is deprived of their symbiote, they must make a DC 10 Constitution save each hour or suffer 1d4 Constitution damage.
system.bonus: Gain advantage on any physical save (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution). If you lose your symbiote, make a DC 10 Constitution save each hour or suffer 1d4 Constitution damage.
